newsitem.title: UK: Kvaerner ups disposal target value.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner ups disposal target value.

text.p: Engineering group Kvaerner ASA said it set a new target for its disposal programme, aiming to sell 15 billion Norwegian crowns of non-core assets.
After acquiring British conglomerate Trafalgar House Plc last year, Kvaerner initially set out for divestments worth 10 billion crowns.
But this target has already been reached, mainly due to higher-than-expected selling prices, president and chief executive Erik Tonseth said.
Kvaerner does not want to sell more assets than previously planned, he told journalists.
Kvaerner's property sale gains in the first half of 1997 were 324 million crowns against 706 million in the same period last year.
